purpose: Trial of one council across four harnesses and four model families (Claude Code, codex, grok, agy). The agenda question is from specimens-2026-11-03.md (reply 1, item 9); the outcome is not acted on.

seats.vantage: independence of verification: the author of a result must never be the one who checks it, and agreement among same-substrate minds is coherence, not independent evidence
the cost and latency of the check itself: what each option costs in time, tokens and the steward's attention, and whether it would change any action
the plan's own author and readers: what kind of review actually improves a draft plan, as opposed to grading it
model-family diversity: what a reviewer from another family catches that one from the same family misses

agenda.title: Who should check a plan like the vsect maturation plan: one independent reviewer from another model family, or a council?
agenda.brief: From specimens-2026-11-03.md (reply 1, item 9): a draft plan for maturing a record-keeping tool (vsect) is waiting for review, and it is open whether one independent reviewer from another model family or a council should check it. The estate's experience: the agent that authors a result is never the one that verifies it; independent checkers found defects in roughly 43% of landings that integrators re-checking their own work had confirmed 116 of 116. Move what you would recommend.
